title: Military City Home Buying: VA Loans and Veteran Programs in San Antonio (2026)
seo_title: VA Loans & Military Home Buying in San Antonio, JBSA (2026) | Kanye Concierge 360
description: Stationed at Joint Base San Antonio or retiring here? VA loan basics for 2026, the funding fee, the Texas Veterans Land Board loan, and down payment help for heroes.
keywords: Texas Veterans Land Board home loan
hero_alt: Military family buying a home in San Antonio
intro: San Antonio is Military City USA. Whether you're PCSing to JBSA-Fort Sam Houston, JBSA-Lackland or JBSA-Randolph, or putting down roots after you separate, you have buying power most people don't.

items: Down payment: none required by the VA (your lender still has to approve you)
Loan limit: none for veterans with full entitlement
Funding fee, first use: 2.15% with under 5% down, 1.5% with 5% down, 1.25% with 10% down
Funding fee, later use with under 5% down: 3.3%
No funding fee: if you receive VA disability compensation, or you're a Purple Heart recipient on active duty

sections.h2: Texas Veterans Land Board home loan
items: Bonus: a lower rate for veterans with a 30% or higher disability rating
Rules: be a Texas resident and live in the home within 60 days, for at least 3 years

sections.h2: Down payment and closing cost help
items: TSAHC Homes for Texas Heroes: up to 5% of the loan for veterans and active military (also teachers, police, fire and EMS)
TDHCA My First Texas Home: veterans can be exempt from the first-time buyer rule
Commute: map the drive to your gate at rush hour before you fall in love with a house
Resale or rent-out: if you could PCS again, buy where homes rent and resell easily
Homestead exemption: file with Bexar Appraisal District after you move in; disabled veterans get 5 years to file late
Flooding: read the seller's disclosure for floodplain and past flooding

faq.q: Do I need a down payment for a VA loan in San Antonio?
faq.a: The VA doesn't require one. Your lender still qualifies you on credit and income.

faq.q: What is the VA funding fee in 2026?
faq.a: For first use with less than 5% down it's 2.15%. It's 1.5% with 5% down and 1.25% with 10% down. Veterans receiving VA disability compensation don't pay it.

faq.q: What is the Texas Veterans Land Board home loan?
faq.a: A fixed-rate Texas loan for eligible veterans up to $832,750, with a lower rate for veterans with a 30% or higher disability rating.
